mentions.name: Silent Shark
mentions.description: This is a tactical map-based WW2 submarine simulator featuring instruments like a periscope stadimeter that computes distance from angle and mast height. A free beta is available, with a full WW2 campaign version planned for release on Steam, the App Store, and the Play Store.
